title: the WSG compiled tables - the play-session reprint manifest with the Table 32 errata
audit_comment: The compiled tables, printed pp. 120-123 (pdf 121-124): thirty of the forty-two book tables reprinted as the play-session reference, each with its from-page. Twenty-nine of the thirty reprints match their landed originals cell for cell (the Table 3 attire grid, Tables 4 and 5, Table 9 with its damage-adjustment and Con-check companions, Tables 11-19, 20-26, 28-29, 33, 36-39, 41 and the fourteen-row Table 42). The ONE exception is the compiled Table 32 (fishing success): the reprint reads Fair daytime 1d6-3 against the original 1d6-2, and Good daytime 1d6-2 against the original 1d8-2 - pinned here as the errata record with the landed rules/wsgfish.h keeping the original readings. The Table 4 attack cells at 90-99 (-1) and 100-109 (-2), shredded by the tesseract pass, were confirmed by direct eyeball and match the pin. This closes the compiled-tables box: the WSG arc is complete.

banner.title: The WSG COMPILED TABLES, R495: the play-session reprint section, printed pp. 120-123 (pdf pages 121-124) - thirty of the forty-two book tables reproduced with their from-pages, the selection limited to the tables most often referred to during play. This round closes the compiled-tables gap box and COMPLETES THE WSG ARC: every section of the Wilderness Survival Guide is now pinned.
banner.provenance: WSG printed pp. 120-123, pdf pages 121-124, extracted at r493-extraction sha 5af0ac2 (tesseract full-text and tsv, x121-x124, 300 dpi; pdf 125 confirmed blank end-matter). Reconciled against the landed originals: every reprinted table was compared cell-for-cell with its R425-R494 pin (rules/wsgdress.h, wsgenvfx.h, wsgheat.h, wsgencum.h, wsganimal.h, wsgvehicle.h, wsgclimb.h, wsgcheck.h, wsgfall.h, wsgtumble.h, wsgstop.h, wsggrap.h, wsgjump.h, wsgnvis.h, wsgswim.h, wsgvessels.h, wsgcapsizing.h, wsgfood.h, wsgfish.h, wsgcarry.h, wsgtents.h, wsgsleep.h, wsgfire.h, wsgfuel.h, wsginfra.h, wsgmount.h). No new grids are pinned: the data lives in the original headers; this round pins the compilation itself - the manifest, the from-pages, the per-table reconciliation, and the one errata.
banner.sentinel: THE SETTLE: twenty-nine of the thirty reprints reconcile with their landed pins cell for cell, including every cell the tesseract pass shredded (the Table 19 stop grid, the Table 20 rows 4-5, the whole Table 23 and Table 24 reads, the Table 25 lower half, the Table 39 hills row, the Table 41 rows 3-4, and the six Table 42 rows whose labels garbled - all settle from the pins with nothing contradicted, and the TSV row-gap geometry confirms the fourteen Table 42 rows and the thirty-manifest in full). The ONE genuine print discrepancy is the compiled Table 32: Fair daytime 1d6-3 (original 1d6-2, both tokens legible and column-aligned at x=1600/1668 on pdf 124) and Good daytime 1d6-2 (original 1d8-2) - an errata-class reprint difference, the first found in the arc, pinned as compiled-side consts with the original pin untouched. The Table 4 attack cells (90-99 = -1, 100-109 = -2) were OCR-shredded (=3 / =0 at conf 31/70) and settled by the user direct eyeball of printed p. 120, matching the pin. The printed page span is 120-123: the footers read 120 (pdf 121), 121 (pdf 122, conf 97) and 123 (pdf 124, conf 97); the pdf 123 footer (printed 122 by the pdf-minus-one rule) OCRs ambiguously as 123 at low confidence - the pdf 124 footer at conf 97 settles the span end.

prev_record: - R494 LANDED 2026-10-16: commit 7dd2f3f (census 419,
pushed ceaff98..7dd2f3f), the WSG WORLD OF WEATHER
appendix part 2 of 2 - the weather EFFECTS system
and the optional rules, printed pp. 112-119. Pinned
as rules/wsgweathx.h with the include after
wsgweather.h (prefixes wwy for the pins and wwt for
the table switch columns), 340 inlines: 220 consts +
63 bools + 1 chain (wwyCycloneDriftFor, limits 6/7,
tail 2) + 56 table columns in 25 sections. Nine
tables: the Roll 2 cross-index (2 rows x 5 bands -
see the lesson below), Table A4 the 33x4
special-weather grid (packed base-10 four-letter
codes A1/C2/D3/G4/M5/S6/T7/X8/Z9), the X dispatch
(7 temp bands x 12 d6 cols), Table A5 humidity
(33x4), the day-1/day-2 before and after adjustment
grids (3x3 each), Table A6 effective temperature
(25x5), Table A7 wind chill (17x8), Table A8 hours
of daylight (15 latitude rows x 12 months in
half-hours). Flips the weather-effects child box
and the parent appendix box: 146 closed / 40 open -
THE APPENDIX IS CLOSED; only the compiled tables
pp. 120-126 remain in the WSG arc. Preflight GREEN
(R494 WSG weather effects audit: bad 0), rverify
GREEN (1102 mutants, 0 missed, double-run clean).
THE R2 DEFECT CLASS (first C++-only catch since the
battery went compiled): the Roll 2 cross-index was
first encoded 1 data row x 10 cols with the count
const wwyRoll2Rows = 2; speclib only walks actual
data rows so the Python mirror read bad 0, but the
emitted audit declares CR2[1][10] and loops
b < wwyRoll2Rows() - row 1 reads out of bounds, all
10 columns hit the -1 defaults, compiled bad
EXACTLY 10. Preflight caught it (the audit return 1
also truncated every audit physically after the
R494 block, so the census flooded with phantom
failures - fallout, not defects). The engine has NO
count-vs-rows gate: a table whose count const
exceeds its data rows is the R494 class; authors
MUST check every table's count == len(data) before
publishing. Fixed by reshaping R2 to the honest 2x5
(cols wwtR2B24/B56/B7/B89/B1012, data
LESSON (delivery): overwriting an EXISTING canvas
with a corrected spec body did NOT re-render the
panel - the user kept copying the stale broken
version; publishing under a NEW canvas name
(r494-splice-fix) fixed the copy. When a spec is
corrected mid-round, publish the fix as a new
canvas, never an in-place overwrite. The ritual
block stays pure shell (the user's standing rule);
the bn launcher is user-side only. User-side spec
md5 b258419d806323abca35fd5e7a20325d (authored
4f1dbaaa49d529e25b14145ac8ed069a - the
